# Subjects of mail messages for internal/jira's notification matcher
# (TestMatchNotificationSubjects). One case a line: "<want> | <subject>",
# want being the issue key the matcher finds or "-" for none. The sender
# matches in every case; the account's selected spaces are ITSD, WEB and
# MOB2 (OPS, HR and ABC exist on the site and are not selected).
#
# In a subject, <repeat:N:text> stands for text N times, <U+XXXX> for that
# code point and <empty> for nothing, so that this file holds no long
# lines, no invisible characters, no letters that only look like others
# and no space at the end of a line. Everything is fictional.

# The site's own notifications, and an automation rule's.
ITSD-42 | [JIRA] (ITSD-42) Printer on the 2nd floor
ITSD-42 | [JIRA] (ITSD-42) Tiskárna ve 2. patře netiskne
WEB-7 | [JIRA] Petr Svoboda commented on (WEB-7) Landing page typo
MOB2-1 | [JIRA] (MOB2-1) Crash on start
ITSD-20 | IT Service Desk: Printer jams (ITSD-20)
ITSD-20 | IT Service Desk: Printer jams (ITSD-20)<U+0020>
WEB-123456789 | Web: nine digits (WEB-123456789)
ITSD-42 | [ITSD-42] Printer on the 2nd floor
ITSD-42 | Re: [JIRA] (ITSD-42) Printer on the 2nd floor
ITSD-42 | Fwd: FW: [JIRA] (ITSD-42) Printer on the 2nd floor
ITSD-42 | (ITSD-42)
ITSD-1 | [JIRA] (ITSD-1) (WEB-2) two keys, the first wins
WEB-2 | [JIRA] [WEB-2] (ITSD-1) two keys, the first wins

# Keys of spaces that are not selected are passed over.
- | [JIRA] (OPS-7) Backup failed
- | Human Resources: Onboarding (HR-3)
ITSD-42 | [JIRA] (OPS-7) relates to (ITSD-42)
- | [JIRA] (ITSDX-42) a longer space key
- | [JIRA] (ITS-42) a shorter space key
- | [JIRA] (XITSD-42) a prefix
- | [JIRA] (MOB-1) the space is MOB2
- | [JIRA] (MOB22-1) the space is MOB2

# No brackets, or not around the key alone.
- | [JIRA] ITSD-42 Printer on the 2nd floor
- | ITSD-42
- | [JIRA] ( ITSD-42 ) spaces inside
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42 ) a space inside
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42, WEB-7) a list
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42] mixed brackets
- | [JIRA] [ITSD-42) mixed brackets
- | [JIRA] {ITSD-42} braces
- | [JIRA] <ITSD-42> angle brackets
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42
- | [JIRA] ITSD-42)
- | (ITSD-
- | (ITSD
- | (
- | [
- | <empty>
- | <U+0020>
- | [JIRA] (see ITSD-42) words before the key
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42: Printer) words after the key
- | https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ITSD-42
- | [JIRA] (https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ITSD-42)

# Numbers.
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-0) zero
- | (ABC-0)
- | (ABC-01)
- | (ABC-1) a space that is not selected
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-01) a leading zero
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-042) a leading zero
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-) no number
- | [JIRA] (ITSD--42) two hyphens
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-4 2) a space in the number
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42a) a letter after the number
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-4.2) a dot
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-1234567890) ten digits
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-99999999999999999999999999999999999999) a long number
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-+42) a sign
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-<U+0664><U+0662>) Arabic-Indic digits
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-<U+FF14><U+FF12>) full-width digits

# Case: a key is capitals, to the letter.
- | [JIRA] (itsd-42) lower case
- | [JIRA] (Itsd-42) mixed case
- | [JIRA] (ITSd-42) mixed case
- | [jira] (web-7) lower case

# Letters of other scripts that look like the key's.
- | [JIRA] (<U+0406><U+0422><U+0405>D-42) Cyrillic I, T and S
- | [JIRA] (IT<U+0405>D-42) one Cyrillic letter
- | [JIRA] (<U+0399><U+03A4>SD-42) Greek iota and tau
- | [JIRA] (<U+FF29><U+FF34><U+FF33><U+FF24>-42) full-width letters
- | [JIRA] (W<U+0415>B-7) Cyrillic E
- | [JIRA] (ITSD<U+2010>42) a Unicode hyphen
- | [JIRA] (ITSD<U+2013>42) an en dash
- | [JIRA] (ITSD<U+2212>42) a minus sign
- | [JIRA] <U+FF08>ITSD-42<U+FF09> full-width parentheses
- | [JIRA] <U+FF3B>ITSD-42<U+FF3D> full-width brackets
- | [JIRA] (IT<U+200B>SD-42) a zero-width space in the key
- | [JIRA] (<U+200B>ITSD-42) a zero-width space before the key
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-42<U+200B>) a zero-width space after the key
- | [JIRA] (ITSD<U+00AD>-42) a soft hyphen
- | [JIRA] (<U+202E>24-DSTI) right-to-left override
- | [JIRA] (<U+FEFF>ITSD-42) a byte order mark
ITSD-42 | <U+202E>[JIRA] (ITSD-42) an override around a real key<U+202C>
ITSD-42 | [JIRA]<U+00A0>(ITSD-42)<U+00A0>no-break spaces around the brackets

# Control characters and header tricks that reached the subject.
- | [JIRA] (ITSD<U+0000>-42) NUL
- | [JIRA] (ITSD<U+000A>-42) a line feed in the key
- | [JIRA] (ITSD-<U+000D><U+000A> 42) a folded key
ITSD-42 | [JIRA]<U+000D><U+000A>From: jira@acme.atlassian.net<U+000D><U+000A>Subject: (ITSD-42)
ITSD-42 | [JIRA]<U+0009>(ITSD-42)<U+0009>tabs

# RFC 2047 encoded words: decoded by the parser before the matcher reads
# the subject; one that stayed encoded is read as it stands.
ITSD-42 | [JIRA] (ITSD-42) Tiskárna – žluťoučký kůň
ITSD-42 | =?UTF-8?Q?[JIRA]_(ITSD-42)_Tisk=C3=A1rna?=
- | =?UTF-8?Q?[JIRA]_=28ITSD-42=29_Tisk=C3=A1rna?=
- | =?UTF-8?B?W0pJUkFdIChJVFNELTQyKSBUaXNrw6FybmE=?=
- | =?UTF-8?Q?[JIRA]_(ITSD=2D42)?=
- | =?ISO-8859-2?Q?(ITSD-?= =?ISO-8859-2?Q?42)?=

# Nesting and many brackets.
ITSD-42 | [(ITSD-42)]
ITSD-42 | ([ITSD-42])
ITSD-42 | [[ITSD-42]]
ITSD-42 | ((ITSD-42))
ITSD-42 | [JIRA] ((((((((ITSD-42))))))))
ITSD-42 | [JIRA] (([ITSD-42) (ITSD-42)
WEB-7 | (ITSD-(WEB-7)42)
- | (ITSD-(WEB-)7)42)
ITSD-42 | <repeat:300:(>ITSD-42)
ITSD-42 | <repeat:300:[(>ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:1000:(>
- | <repeat:1000:[>
- | <repeat:500:()>
- | <repeat:250:(A-1)>
- | <repeat:100:(ITSD-0)>
- | <repeat:90:(OPS-12345)>
ITSD-5 | <repeat:90:(OPS-12345)>(ITSD-5)
- | <repeat:1000:(ITSD->
- | <repeat:1000:(ITSD>
- | <repeat:4000:A>

# Length: a header line holds 998 bytes; the matcher reads 1024 of the
# subject and no further.
ITSD-42 | <repeat:989:x>(ITSD-42)
ITSD-42 | (ITSD-42)<repeat:989:x>
ITSD-42 | <repeat:1015:x>(ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:1016:x>(ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:1020:x>(ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:1024:x>(ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:100000:x>(ITSD-42)
ITSD-42 | <repeat:507:é>(ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:508:é>(ITSD-42)
- | <repeat:1019:x>(ITSD-42345)
